description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40). Notice under Section 2(7).
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal notification regarding the parliamentary approval of a Proclamation made under the Public Security Ordinance. It deals with the activation of a specific part of a legal ordinance, which is a matter of legal and regulatory procedure. This fits the definition of **Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5)**, which includes legal notices, statutory instruments, and the operation of laws and ordinances.
